page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, then a printed ornament, the title block of the oration (large heading, italic subtitle line, date), and one paragraph of text in a single column. Page number at top left. Right edge shows a sliver of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: ORATIO VI. DE RESVRRECTIONE CHRISTI.
Recitata publicè à Christophoro Vulteio Weterano II. April. 1585.
main_text.p: QVàm vellem, Illustris & Generose Comes, Rector Magnifice, Reverendi & Clariss. D. D. & professores, Præceptores venerandi, nobilis deniq; & studiosa juvenum corona: Quàm vellè, inquam, dicendi ex hoc loco partes alii demandatas esse, qui quam sum ego, exactiore doctrina, judicio maturiore, facultate dicendi uberiore, instructus argumentum hujus temporis illustrare, laudabili Academiæ hujus inclytæ[?] consuetudini, vestrumq; omnium exspectationi honestissimæ satisfacere posset? Quanta enim argumenti hujus dignitas? Quanta majestas Christi à mortuis resurgentis, de Satana, peccato & morte triumphum agentis? Contrà verò, quanta doctrinæ meæ tenuitas? quanta ingenii infirmitas, quàm curta in dicendo supellex? Quoniam verò consuetudo Academiæ, ut aliquid hoc tempore, & authoritas fidelissimorum præceptorum, ut à me dicere-

page.notes: The initial Q is a large woodcut letter, joined to "vellem" as "QVàm". The word "inclytæ" is printed with a letter that looks like "!" in the scan, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "dicere-" is printed at the right below the last line. The line-end hyphens in "hu-jus" and "dicere-" are printed. "demanda / tas" is broken at a line end without a printed hyphen, so it is written as "demandatas". The subtitle "Weterano" is hyphenated across the line as "We-/terano" and is written whole. The title block is set in roman and italic, with small capitals in the subtitle. No printing errors were corrected.
